performance.requests_per_level: one request per logical concurrent client
performance.pool_policy: one persistent verifier process per available logical CPU, capped by the largest concurrency level

measurement.matrix: all ticket-device pairs in every round
measurement.profile_delivery: authorization-gate outcome; identical Profile ciphertext generation is not repeated for every matrix cell

ablation_warning: AURA-RSP w/o secret binding is an experiment-only control and is not the normal protocol implementation.
